Top Level Setext
================

Setext headings parse as their equivalent ATX level, so this is a level one
heading and the next one is level two.

Second Level Setext
-------------------

The dashed rule above is a heading underline, not a thematic break, because a
non-empty line sits directly above it.

### Deep child

A level three heading under a setext level two heading, which is where a naive
heading stack loses the path.
